in_sanskrit.name: शर्वथा
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Goddess Saraswati (Saraswatī), Goddess of learning, arts, wisdom and knowledge.

in_marathi.name: Sharvitha
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Goddess of knowledge and learning
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sharvitha हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Derived from the Sanskrit word 'saraswati' which represents the Goddess of knowledge, learning, and music.
